testPlan.title: Issue 18: wheel zoom after the editor

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: In a vehicle: open, close, scroll
test.passLog: exit: the screen is on the vehicle's camera
test.hint: In a vehicle: Alt+F, then Esc, then scroll the wheel. The camera zooms. Ticks itself on exit when the screen is on the vehicle's camera.

test.title: Leave the vehicle with the editor open, then Esc
test.hint: In a vehicle: Alt+F, leave or switch vehicle however you can (E, Tab, a quick-select mod), then Esc. The screen is where you are and the wheel still zooms there. Skip if nothing leaves the vehicle.

test.title: FlyoverWheelReport prints one line
test.hint: Console (~): FlyoverWheelReport. One line with context, cursor, renderCamera, zoomEvent, the AD flags and three wheel counts. In a vehicle renderCamera=same.

test.title: Clicking a vehicle from above does not enter it
test.hint: Editor open, Select tool: left-click a parked vehicle seen from above. You stay where you are and the editor stays open.
